text: Figure 3.3: Define Alias Names Task Definition Define Alias Names Package AUTOSAR Root::M2::Methodology::Methodology Library::Common Elements::T asks Brief Description Define a set of alias names for AUTOSAR model elements. Description The usual mechanism for defining global names for nested elements within an AUTOSAR XML model is the Flat Map. However in the cooperation with non-AUTOSAR tools, there are uses cases which require additional alias names which can be defined by this task. It can be applied on System and on ECU level as well. Possible use cases are for example: • The names defined by an ECU Flat Map, System Flat Map or Partial Flat Map shall be superseded when used by an external tool (e.g. in order to use a more general string format). • Resolve name conflicts for elements which cannot be referred in the context of a Flat Map (e.g. for elements directly defined in the scope of ARPackages, like System Constants to be displayed by A2L tools). Relation Type Related Element Mult. Note Consumes Delivered Atomic Software Components 0..1 Needed for definition of alias names in the scope of delivered software components. Consumes System Description 0..1 Needed for definition of alias names with system, system extract or ECU scope, depending of the role of the System Description.
